findings.title: Installed version drift is described as blocking, but the frozen checker only reports it

evidence.observation: accepts(entry) checks registry identity/integrity metadata but not version equality; a version mismatch returns verified:true with drift.
A verified drift is stored in installedDrift, without emitting a diagnostic.
status/passed depend on violations and diagnostics. installedLockDrift is explicitly informational and is not part of the decision.
HOW forbids changes to decision logic and allows only the literal additional groups.

findings.concrete_counterexample: For an otherwise valid reached registry installation with matching name/path/resolved/integrity metadata, keep the committed version at 1.0.0 and set the installed manifest version to 2.0.0. The frozen code returns verified:true plus drift and does not make this condition a blocking diagnostic. This is a static branch trace, not an executed fixture or a live PASS claim.
findings.impact: The exact proposal promises an installed fence that its permitted BUILD cannot provide, and item 35 only specifies the unverified-dependency negative, which would not detect this false drift claim.
findings.required_revision: Align line 23 with frozen behavior: unverified installed dependencies and installed product findings remain blocking; installed version drift retains its current informational semantics. If blocking version drift is actually intended, it needs its own explicit scope/contract review rather than being introduced through these 13 exception rows. Do not broaden this qualification or silently change the checker.

findings.title: The per-pin symlink oracle requires exception counts after discovery has already aborted

evidence.observation: files() throws unverified_source_symlink when a discovered directory entry is a symlink.
Source discovery walks packages before exception matching is reached.
pinsHold and exception counts run only after discovery/analysis complete.
The existing byte-identical symlink negative correctly accepts an early physical-identity exception using toThrow.

findings.concrete_counterexample: Replace packages/platform/src/plugin-execution-core.ts with a symlink to a byte-identical regular copy in an isolated future fixture. The frozen files() walk throws before there is an audit report. The oracle cannot inspect dependent=0 and independent=1/8 counts. No symlink fixture was created or executed during this review.
findings.impact: Item 33 would reject the existing correct fail-closed path or force an unauthorized discovery rewrite just to produce counts. This is an oracle mismatch, not evidence that symlinks are accepted.
findings.required_revision: Specify early physical-identity/discovery rejection as a valid required result for source/ancestor symlinks. Assert dependent-zero and unchanged independent counts only when an audit report is returned. Keep byte-drift/missing-pin and symlink cases distinct in the oracle; retain fail-closed behavior and all matcher constraints.

limitations.effect: No comparison with an externally supplied sentinel/seal can be claimed. The 29 packet files have independently measured exact pre/post byte hashes and metadata. No substitute was fetched.
No checker, sealed source, TypeScript compiler, tests, build, platform/sandbox probe, runner or guest was executed. Planned emission/negative tests and post-BUILD I1 remain unperformed.

The approval record hashes for 0214/0215 match their sealed documents. This review does not fetch the referenced decision packet, prior reports, absent 0215 source closure, public workspace manifests or compiler; it does not reaccept 0214/0215 or prove a live closure.

not_findings: All 13 full-expression SHA16, normalized lines, literal paths, reasons, max=1 and row/site identities match the frozen bytes.
All 12 proposed file pins match physical regular canonical files.

The four descriptor sites compare own safeParse descriptor values to captured function identities; the reviewed sites neither invoke the safeParse function nor invoke its accessor. This is bounded by trusted host composition.
The 9 sandbox JS sites retain the reviewed TS behavior on static inspection; universal guest/OS containment is not an acceptance criterion.
The three proposed groups are absent from the frozen active table. The four approved0215 groups retain exactly 19/14/3/10 occurrences with identical reason/pins/sites.
